requirements.parent: Parent open, due October 1 (first valid annotation), upcoming/not overdue as of September 30, 2026.
requirements.child: Child open, independently undated; overdue classification unknown.
requirements.completed: Completed due September 29; not actionable overdue.
requirements.invalid: Invalid date yields open undated task; overdue classification unknown.
requirements.fence: Fenced checkbox example is not an actual task.

rubric: Metadata must match the actual checkbox text.
Distinguish an inline-code annotation on a real task from an entire fenced-code example.
